fact: Rwanda reports that since December 2016 its Integrated Electronic Case Management System has connected 194 investigation stations/posts (with 59 prosecution offices, 63 courts and 13 prisons), on data generated 3 September 2020.
title: National report submitted in accordance with paragraph 5 of the annex to Human Rights Council resolution 16/21: Rwanda (A/HRC/WG.6/37/RWA/1)
publisher: United Nations Human Rights Council, Working Group on the Universal Periodic Review
